text:
You’re buying me a wood-fired pizza with spicy soppressata, roasted mushrooms, hot honey, and a slightly unreasonable amount of fresh mozzarella—charred at the edges, naturally.

I’m drinking an ice-cold Mexican Coke with lime. The sharp fizz cuts through the cheese and spice, while the lime keeps the hot honey from taking over.

Basically: salty, smoky, spicy, sweet, bubbly. A highly optimized evening. 🍕🥤

A wood-fired margherita pizza with extra basil, plus a side of hot honey for strategic dipping. I’m drinking an ice-cold sparkling lemonade with it.

Why? The pizza is simple enough that every ingredient has to earn its place—charred crust, bright tomato, creamy mozzarella, fragrant basil—while the hot honey adds a sweet little ambush. Sparkling lemonade cuts through the richness and resets the palate for the next slice. 🍕🍋

You’re buying me a **pepperoni pizza with jalapeños, pineapple, and hot honey**, well-charred at the edges. Salty, spicy, sweet, and just controversial enough to make dinner interesting.

I’m drinking a **cold, crisp pilsner** with it—the bitterness cuts through the cheese and pepperoni, while the bubbles reset the palate for the next gloriously reckless bite. 🍕🍺

You’re buying me a **wood-fired pizza with spicy pepperoni, roasted jalapeños, mushrooms, hot honey, and a well-charred crust**.

I’m drinking an **ice-cold Mexican Coke with lime**.

Why: the pizza hits smoky, spicy, savory, earthy, and sweet all at once, while the Coke’s acidity and carbonation cut through the cheese—and the lime keeps the whole situation from becoming too heavy. Also, I’m apparently incapable of ordering a restrained pizza. 🍕🥤

You’re buying me a wood-fired pizza with spicy soppressata, hot honey, mozzarella, and pickled jalapeños—charred enough to have those blistered edges.

I’m drinking an ice-cold Mexican Coke with lime. The sharp fizz and citrus cut through the cheese and sweetness, while the cola plays nicely with the smoky crust.

Basically: spicy, salty, sweet, acidic, smoky. Maximum contrast, no boring bites. 🍕🥤
